gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the BLUETTI Elite 300 (ChatGPT's pick, 3,014.4 Wh) is missing from BLUETTI's own compatibility lists for its B300K and B500K expansion batteries. The B300K list names AC200L, AC200MAX, AC300 and AC500. The B500K list names Apex 300, AC300, AC500, AC200L and AC200MAX, and the store sells it as 'B500K for Apex 200 & Apex 300'. So the Elite 300 can't grow to cover the 30 % heater-duty case (about 3.2 kWh). The expandable BLUETTI Apex 200 (2,560 Wh, $1,099) takes B300K/B500K, and BLUETTI sells Apex 200 + B300K as a $2,199 bundle (5,324.8 Wh).
standout_why: I compared against reefs.com (cited; tests the Elite 100 V2 only, with no expansion or compatibility content), Dealectric's own current page (cited; covers ECO mode and UPS times but says nothing about which battery fits which station), ChatGPT's EcoFlow answers (they say the DELTA 2 Max is 'expandable to 6,144 Wh' but never mention that the Elite 300 can't be expanded), and Petco (cited; returned 403, so I couldn't read it). The rivals carry part of this idea, that some stations expand, but none maps batteries to the stations they fit, and none says the recommended Elite 300 has no expansion path.
decides: This changes the pick for a cold room. At 30 % heater duty the page's own budget needs about 3.2 kWh, and the Elite 300 gives about 2.6 kWh usable with no way to add more. The Apex 200 + B300K bundle (5,324.8 Wh, about 4.5 kWh usable at 85 %) covers 30 % duty with room to spare and nearly covers 50 % duty (4.6 kWh). It costs $0.41/Wh against the Elite 300's $0.40/Wh. In a warm room at 15–20 % duty the Elite 300 still wins: the Apex 200 alone (about 2.2 kWh usable) has less energy than the Elite 300 for $100 less. The AC200L also takes B300K/B500K, but BLUETTI US shows it unavailable today.

findings.label: Stations the maker lists as compatible
findings.value: AC200L, AC200MAX, AC300, AC500 on the main listing; separate store SKUs 'B300K for Apex 300/200' and 'B300K for AC200L/AC300'. No Elite-series model or AC180 is listed.
findings.note: Quoted from the store listing: 'Effortlessly integrates with BLUETTI AC200L, AC200MAX, AC300, and AC500 power stations.' Read with storecheck.py search on bluettipower.com. B300K costs $1,099 (compare-at $1,699).

findings.label: Stations the maker lists as compatible
findings.value: Apex 300, AC300, AC500, AC200L, AC200MAX 'and upcoming models'; titled 'B500K for Apex 200 & Apex 300'. No Elite-series model is listed.
findings.note: 5,120 Wh, $1,599 (from $2,000). One CA90 expansion cable is in the box. The page names no exclusions explicitly, so the Elite 300 exclusion comes from it being absent from the list.

findings.label: Expansion support on the maker's product page
findings.value: None stated; the Recommended Accessories section is empty and no expansion battery is named
findings.note: The page also says '10 ms UPS keeps security systems, aquariums, and workstations running.' Price $1,199 (storecheck, Black Friday Early Access Nov 5–18). The V1.1 manual contents (ManualsLib) have no expansion-battery section and say AC-ECO and DC-ECO are on by default.

findings.label: Price
findings.note: storecheck.py product, single variant, in stock. $1,199 / 3,014.4 Wh = $0.40/Wh.

findings.label: Capacity, expansion and UPS
findings.value: 2,560 Wh; up to six B300K or B500K per unit; UPS ≤15 ms
findings.source_title: Apex 200 Versatile Power Station · BLUETTI US
findings.note: UPS has to be turned on in the BLUETTI app. The page warns that transfer 'may not meet every device's requirements'. Warranty length and ECO mode aren't stated on the page.

findings.label: Price (base and with B300K)
findings.note: storecheck.py search on bluettipower.com 'Apex 200'. Bundle 2,560 + 2,764.8 = 5,324.8 Wh; × 0.85 ≈ 4,526 Wh usable; $2,199 / 5,324.8 = $0.41/Wh. Apex 200 + B500K costs $2,749 (7,680 Wh).

findings.value: $899 listed, shown unavailable (sold out), along with its bundles
findings.note: storecheck.py search returned available=false. It's the cheapest B300K/B500K-compatible station, but you can't buy it from BLUETTI US today.

findings.label: Expansion support and price on maker's page
findings.value: $899; the page's FAQ asks 'Is the Elite 200 V2 expandable with B80, B300, or B230?' but shows no answer, and it isn't on the B300K or B500K compatibility lists

unsourced: A maker statement in so many words that the Elite 300 or Elite 200 V2 is 'not expandable': the product pages say nothing on it, the Elite 300 US manual PDF was over the fetch size limit, and I couldn't extract the Elite 200 V2 manual PDF (Ghostscript-compressed, local pdftotext needed approval). The exclusion here rests on both models being absent from BLUETTI's B300K and B500K compatibility lists.
